metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Engine Removal, Refit & Final Testing | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Professional engine removal, refit, and final testing for Mercedes-Benz. Full process from disconnection to road test. Part of our rebuild and replacement service.
h1: Mercedes-Benz Engine Removal, Refit & Final Testing
lede: Every engine rebuild or replacement at our workshop includes a meticulous removal, precise refit, and comprehensive final testing - ensuring your Mercedes performs as it should.

sections.heading: What Engine Removal, Refit & Testing Involves

blocks.html: Removing and refitting an engine is a skilled, labour-intensive process that requires careful attention to detail. At Mercedes Garage, we follow a structured procedure that ensures every component is correctly handled and every system is thoroughly tested before your vehicle leaves the workshop.

chips.label: Disconnect battery and all electrical harnesses
Drain all fluids (engine oil, coolant, refrigerant, etc.)
Remove intake, exhaust, cooling, and fuel system connections
Carefully lift the unit out using an engine hoist
Refill all fluids with correct specifications
**Start-up test**
chips.desc: ensure engine fires and runs smoothly

chips.label: **Running test**
chips.desc: check under various loads and RPMs

chips.label: **Road test**
chips.desc: validate performance under real driving conditions

blocks.html: **Mercedes-specific considerations:** Engine bay layout varies significantly across models - from the compact A-Class to the spacious Sprinter. AMG engines have more complex plumbing and electronic systems. Certain models, like the SLS AMG with a mid-engine layout, require special lifting equipment. Our technicians are trained on all Mercedes platforms and use the correct tools for each job.

paras: Part of our rebuild or replacement service - from **£2,200**

Removal, refit, and final testing are included in our fixed-price quotes for engine rebuilds and replacements. For standalone removal/refit work (e.g., to replace other components), we provide a separate quote.

ul: **Typical labour time:** 15-25 workshop hours for removal and refit

paras: Every job is quoted individually - contact us for a precise estimate for your vehicle.

blocks.html: We perform removal, refit, and testing on virtually every Mercedes-Benz model. Below are some of the most common ones we work on.
For a complete list of all models and engine codes, see our [engine rebuild service page](/mercedes-engine-rebuild).

steps.title: Vehicle Reception
steps.body: We receive your vehicle, confirm the work required, and carry out an initial inspection.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: We disconnect all systems, drain fluids, and safely lift the engine out using appropriate equipment.

steps.title: Rebuild / Preparation
steps.body: The engine is either rebuilt (if part of a rebuild service) or the replacement unit is prepared.

steps.title: Engine Refit
steps.body: We lower the unit into the bay, reconnect all systems, and refill fluids to manufacturer specifications.

steps.title: Start-up & Bench Testing
steps.body: We perform initial start-up checks, measure oil pressure and compression, and run the engine at various RPMs.

steps.title: Road Test & Final Inspection
steps.body: We road-test the vehicle to verify real-world performance, check for leaks, and complete a final sign-off.

items.q: How long does engine removal and refit take?
items.a: Typically, removal and refit take 15-25 workshop hours. If a full rebuild is included, add 10-15 hours. We'll provide a precise timeline during the quote stage.

items.q: Are all tests included in the price?
items.a: Yes, our fixed-price quotes for rebuilds and replacements include all removal, refit, and final testing - from start-up checks to road testing.

items.q: Do you handle AMG models with complex systems?
items.a: Absolutely. Our technicians are trained on all AMG platforms, including the complexities of M156, M157, M177, and M178 engines. We have the specialist tools and knowledge to work on these high-performance units.

items.q: What if my vehicle is a Sprinter or a van?
items.a: We regularly work on commercial vehicles, including Sprinters, Vitos, and V-Class. The removal and refit process is adapted to the larger bay and different layout, but we follow the same rigorous quality standards.

items.q: Do I need to bring the car in or can you collect?
items.a: We offer nationwide recovery from £70. We can collect your vehicle and return it after the work is complete.
